item.description: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is intensifying traffic enforcement this summer, deploying additional deputies and launching a new targeting initiative aimed at reducing speeding and reckless driving across the county. item.title: Humane Society of the Treasure Coast seeks fosters and adopters during shelter renovation
item.description: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast is calling on the community to foster or adopt animals as the organization enters phase two of a major facility renovation.

item.title: JetBlue ending direct flights from Vero Beach to JFK Airport in September
item.description: JetBlue is ending its direct flights between New York's JFK Airport and Vero Beach Regional Airport, citing low passenger demand for the route that launched in December.

item.title: Florida Panthers announce 2026-27 regular season schedule with home opener in October
item.description: The Florida Panthers will open the 2026-27 NHL season on the road against the Stanley Cup Champion Carolina Hurricanes on September 29 before returning for their home opener on October 11.

item.title: Miami Heat introduce Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis Jr. at Kaseya Center
item.description: The Miami Heat officially introduced two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo and forward Bobby Portis Jr. at the Kaseya Center on Thursday, with both players receiving standing ovations from fans.

item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 in World Cup semifinal with late goals
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit with goals from Enzo Fernandez and Lautaro Martinez in the final minutes to defeat England 2-1 on Wednesday and advance to the World Cup final.

item.title: Spain advances to World Cup final with 2-0 victory over France
item.description: Mikel Oyarzabal scored from the penalty spot and Pedro Porro added another goal as Spain defeated France 2-0 on Tuesday to reach its first World Cup final since 2010.

item.title: Atlanta increases security for England-Argentina World Cup semifinal
item.description: Atlanta police announced increased personnel and resources for Wednesday's England-Argentina World Cup semifinal match, considered one of the tournament's highest-risk games due to longstanding tensions between the two nations.

item.title: England and Argentina renew fierce World Cup rivalry in semifinal
item.description: England and Argentina meet in Atlanta on Wednesday in a World Cup semifinal that resumes one of the fiercest rivalries in international soccer, with the winner advancing to face Spain in the final.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts earn top 15 finish at nationals, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month, qualifying them for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly have emerged as frontrunners in Florida's governor race as the primary approaches. item.title: Security First Insurance lowers homeowners rates by 5.6% statewide
item.description: Security First Insurance is lowering homeowners insurance rates by an average of 5.6%, the latest in a series of rate decreases the Florida-based company has made over the last two years.

item.title: Clearwater financier Leo Govoni faces federal charges in $100 million theft scheme
item.description: Federal prosecutors allege Leo Govoni and accountant John Witeck stole more than $100 million from a nonprofit that managed trust funds for people with disabilities and other special needs.

item.title: Court hearing scheduled on challenge to Fishback's gubernatorial eligibility
item.description: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback faces a ballot challenge alleging he does not meet Florida's seven-year residency requirement for governors.

item.title: DeSantis remains neutral as Trump endorses Donalds in governor race
item.description: President Donald Trump has endorsed Byron Donalds in the Republican primary for governor, while Gov. Ron DeSantis has remained publicly neutral despite appointing Jay Collins as lieutenant governor.

item.title: Florida homeowners pay highest average insurance premium in nation at $8,292
item.description: Online firm Insurify reports that in 2026 Florida homeowners pay the highest average premium in the country at $8,292.

item.title: Democratic poll shows Jolly ahead of Donalds in Florida general election matchup
item.description: A June survey commissioned by a Democratic group showed David Jolly leading Byron Donalds 47% to 42% among registered voters and 49% to 43% among likely voters.
